transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: First Glasgow's Glasgow Airport Express 500 connects the airport with the city centre in as little as 15 minutes. Buses leave from stance 1 at the airport and stance 46 at Buchanan Bus Station.

taxi.title: Taxis
taxi.text: Official white taxis wait directly outside the terminal. No advance booking is needed for journeys from the airport.

parking.title: Parking
parking.hint: Long Stay: up to 1 hour free
parking.text: The Long Stay car park offers up to 1 hour of free parking for picking up or dropping off a passenger. A free shuttle bus connects it with the terminal.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Glasgow_Airport_WiFi offers 1 hour of free access at limited speed; registration is required. Select the duration of access when connecting.

about: First Glasgow’s Glasgow Airport Express links Glasgow Airport with the city centre.
